reasoning_content: The downloaded key file is actually a PGP signed message (armored format), not a raw public key. The apt `signed-by` option requires the key in keyring format. Let's extract the public key and convert it to a keyring.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "gpg --dearmor < /usr/share/keyrings/pgdg.gpg > /usr/share/keyrings/pgdg.gpg 2>/dev/null || { apt-get install -y -qq gnupg > /dev/null 2>&1; gpg --dearmor < /usr/share/keyrings/pgdg.gpg > /usr/share/keyrings/pgdg.gpg; }\nhead -1 /usr/share/keyrings/pgdg.gpg\napt-get update -qq 2>&1 | tail -2; apt-cache policy postgresql-15 2>/dev/null | head -3", "description": "Fix GPG key format", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Dearmor PGDG key and retry apt update"}
